fields.title: Name column
fields.description: The column that should be used as name. The value from this column is used as result for matching pairs.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Distance vector column
fields.description: The column with the distance vector to use.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Comparator
fields.description: The comparator to use when comparing a pair's distance against the threshold.

fields.title: Threshold
fields.description: The threshold value against which the distance of each pair is compared.

fields.title: Add distance column
fields.description: Select this option to add the distance between the extracted pairs as an additional column.

fields.title: Cache distances
fields.description: Enabling this option speeds up the processing but requires more memory.
